end.summary:
Named earthworm and ant while discussing soil animals.
Asked why earthworms may be found in damp places.

end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter, including earthworms and ants. They noticed that red ants move fast and discussed looking under leaves. Pihu mixed up earthworms and other crawling creatures with insects; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, sort pictures or examples into “insects” and “not insects,” including an earthworm, ant, beetle, and millipede.
